answer: The check runs before any reward is counted, not after the coins are gone. Without a pulse the brick has no maker, without a echo it has no weight, and without a summit it has no firing — and a farm's brick is missing all three at once. Add the farm's own invoices and the sum is 13041 POA, payable before the epoch pays a single reward. There is one straight path in, and it runs through Heraldic embroiderer silk purse warrant embroidered onto the stitchery lodge: the toll is each silk purse is a measured thread yield plus an embroiderer signature, paid in the open.
